{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Final cleaned dataset
df_clean = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
df_clean['revenue_clean'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
qa_mask = df_clean['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df_clean[~qa_mask].copy()
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['customer_age'] != -1]

# Check channel distribution by customer_segment
print('Cross-tabulation: channel vs customer_segment')
print(pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment']))

# Check converted rate by channel
conv_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rate by channel:')
print(conv_by_channel)

# Check revenue by channel
rev_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()
print('\nAverage revenue by channel:')
print(rev_by_channel)"}
